basic_info.description: Highly desirable, timeless classic in the beautiful Outer Richmond neighborhood. This home offers the perfect blend of coastal charm and city convenience, located just steps from Geary Boulevard with easy access to MUNI. The neighborhood is known for its popular restaurants and coffee shops, including Sweet Time Dessert, La Promenade Café, Boa’s, Diamond Coffee & Pastry, Kiss of Matcha, Lime Tree Southeast Asian Kitchen, Good Luck Dim Sum, Thai Charcoal BBQ, and many more highly rated establishments. Enjoy close proximity to Golden Gate Park—perfect for picnics, golf, pickleball, biking, or leisurely walks. Other nearby attractions include the Legion of Honor, Lands End, the famous Cliff House, the de Young Museum, and the California Academy of Sciences. This home offers an unbeatable location, abundant potential, and classic charm. Don’t miss this unique opportunity to own a piece of San Francisco history in the heart of Outer Richmond. The property features 3 bedrooms and 1 bathroom, a spacious living room, and a formal dining room with high ceilings. Beautiful hardwood floors flow throughout the home, adding warmth and timeless character to the space. An additional room is located on the first level —perfect for guests, extended family.
